_comment: Canonical registry of the six convening methods (advisor-convening-methods-v2). Stdlib JSON only (no yaml in env). The registry is the SOLE source of truth for field-sets, entry gates, phases, and refusals; the historical-council-sources README is a human-readable summary derived from it. Validate with: python3 jixia/validate_registry.py

jixia.practical_selection: question-driven triage: select the smallest useful mix of advisors from claude/agents/ by relevance, adding a counter-lens only when it materially improves the answer
jixia.entry_gate: the user needs everyday counsel or a right-sized set of lenses
jixia.refusal: redirect when the prompt needs formal adjudication, audit, stakeholder treaty-making, or habit-loop design more than general counsel

seven-sages.practical_selection: question-driven: cap active voices at seven, drawing the smallest useful set from claude/agents/ by relevance to the planning question
seven-sages.entry_gate: the user wants bounded breadth on an ambiguous planning question
seven-sages.refusal: redirect when the question needs evidence trial, source-law interpretation, operational inspection, or long coaching cadence

areopagus.practical_selection: question-driven: add question-relevant advisors from claude/agents/ alongside the default historical reps when a practical lens is useful
areopagus.entry_gate: the user needs a consequential decision reviewed before action
areopagus.refusal: refuse routine brainstorming or advice when there is no consequential decision to adjudicate

historical_roster.source_title: Aristotle, Constitution of the Athenians, trans. H. Rackham, 1935
historical_roster.source_note: Supports former-archon membership and law-guardian tradition; late fourth-century, source-layered, use with source-critical caveats.

historical_roster.source_title: Douglas M. MacDowell, Athenian Homicide Law in the Age of the Orators, Manchester University Press, 1963
historical_roster.source_note: Anchors the Areopagus as a specialized homicide court; jurisdiction-specific, not a generic review board.

historical_roster.source_title: T. E. Rihll, 'Democracy Denied: Why Ephialtes Attacked the Areiopagus,' JHS 115 (1995), 87-98
historical_roster.source_note: Power-limiter lens focused on mandate control and accountability; not an Areopagus member, represents democratic correction.

junto.practical_selection: question-driven: select advisors from claude/agents/ that aid improvement practice, mutual aid, and civic artifact production
junto.entry_gate: the user needs self-improvement, operating cadence, or civic/practical improvement
junto.refusal: redirect when the issue needs formal ruling, red-team inspection, or stakeholder authority balancing rather than improvement practice

parishad.practical_selection: question-driven: add question-relevant advisors from claude/agents/ alongside the default historical reps when a practical lens is useful
parishad.entry_gate: the user needs tradeoffs resolved across roles, duties, sources of authority, or stakeholders
parishad.refusal: redirect when the ask has no real role/source conflict and only needs tactical advice or audit

historical_roster.source_title: Richard W. Lariviere, The Naradasmrti, 1989; rev. 2003
historical_roster.source_note: Interprets injunctions and resolves conflicts among sources; source-constrained hermeneutics, not generic ethics.

historical_roster.source_title: Patrick Olivelle, Manu's Code of Law: A Critical Edition and Translation of the Manava-Dharmasastra, Oxford University Press, 2005
historical_roster.source_note: Source-reciter/exegete of the dharma texts; normative Brahmanical jurisprudence, not enacted positive law nor a modern lawyer.

historical_roster.source_title: Richard W. Lariviere, The Naradasmrti, 1989; rev. 2003
historical_roster.source_note: Court procedure, pleading, and titles-of-law lens; attributed textual sage, not a stable historical person.

yushitai.practical_selection: question-driven: add question-relevant advisors from claude/agents/ alongside the default historical reps when a practical lens is useful
yushitai.entry_gate: the user needs accountability, audit, remonstrance, or failure-mode detection
yushitai.refusal: redirect when the ask needs open-ended ideation or balanced synthesis rather than inspection and accountability

historical_roster.source_title: Charles O. Hucker, The Censorial System of Ming China, Stanford University Press, 1966
historical_roster.source_note: Strong inspection/impeachment lens; office functions shift by dynasty, not a general reviewer.

historical_roster.source_title: Charles O. Hucker, The Censorial System of Ming China, Stanford University Press, 1966
historical_roster.source_note: Field-evidence, local-failure, and anti-capture lens; period-specific to censorial circuits.

historical_roster.source_title: Charles O. Hucker, The Censorial System of Ming China, Stanford University Press, 1966
historical_roster.source_note: Focuses on misconduct classification and documented accusation; not a generic critic.
